capabilities: Convert pasted \( \) and \[ \] delimiters into inline and display math
Recover original TeX from rendered HTML that preserves KaTeX, MathML, or MathJax annotations
Wrap bare TeX expressions in prose as inline math and formula-only lines as display math
Protect code blocks, URLs, Markdown links, and existing math from reprocessing
Fall back to native Obsidian paste when no eligible formula is found
extras: Mobile devices have not been tested and clipboard behavior can vary by platform; the README notes Community Plugins review status is still pending.
problem: Pasting AI responses or rich text into Obsidian leaves math in \( \) / \[ \] delimiters, bare TeX, or rendered HTML, which the editor does not render without manual fixing.

relations.evidence: automatically converts LaTeX math from ChatGPT, Codex, and other sources
converts LaTeX math from ChatGPT, Codex, and other sources to Obsidian's native math syntax

summary: Paste handler that converts LaTeX math from ChatGPT, Codex, and other sources into Obsidian's native $...$ and $$...$$ math syntax.
